### Master's thesis

*The Dawn of Advanced Collaborative Practices* uses thematic and social network analysis to examine interdisciplinary collaboration within Boise State University's Grand Challenges initiative.

[Read the thesis](https://doi.org/10.18122/td.2143.boisestate){target="_blank"}

:::

::: {.feature-card}

### Mountain Bluebird research

This peer-reviewed study examines relationships between temperature and the breeding phenology of Mountain Bluebirds in southern Idaho using a long-term community-science dataset.

[View the publication](https://doi.org/10.1676/22-00112){target="_blank"}

:::
